subject: Odissi (Dance)
notes: Schools offer one style. Theory (30 marks, 2 hours) has no unit-wise split; practical is 70 marks.
Students are presumed to have preliminary training in the style.

chapters.name: History of Indian Dance
topics: A brief history of Indian dance

chapters.name: Myths in Odissi
topics: Kaliya daman, Dashavatar, vastra haran, Nataraja, Draupadi cheer haran, Neuni Chura

chapters.name: Odissi Terms (Class XI)
topics: Nritta, nritya, natya; matra, laya, taal, avartana, vibhaga; tandava, lasya; natyadharmi, lokadharmi; devadasi and mahari

chapters.name: Odissi Repertoire
topics: Mangalacharan, batu or sthayi, pallavi, abhinaya, moksha or tandav dance

chapters.name: Elementary Steps
topics: Ten steps each in chauk and tribhanga set to ektali in ekgun, dugun, chaugun

chapters.name: Arasa
topics: One arasa in chaturasra jaati; recitation of the sthayi ukuta

chapters.name: Mangalacharan
topics: Demonstration and recitation of ukutas; raga and tala; hastas
Mancha pravesha, pushpanjali, bhumi pranam, ishta deva vandana, trikhandi

chapters.name: Asamyuta Mudras
topics: Asamyuta mudras from the Abhinaya Darpana
